meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 装好后，你给它一个来源——目录、网址、贴进来的笔记，或刚才这段对话——它就会梳理出可复用的步骤，写成新的 .claude/skills/<名称>/SKILL.md，或把新经验并进已有技能。
howto.when: 当你说 /learn、给出「/learn <路径或网址>」、「把这段做成技能」等说法，或要更新某个已有技能时触发。

say.text: /learn 把刚才这套部署流程做成技能
say.note: 从当前对话里提炼出可复用步骤
抓取网页内容，生成对应技能

say.text: 把 wow-on-steam-deck 技能更新一下，补进这次的新发现
say.note: 原地改已有技能，不覆盖重写

howto.what_en: Once installed, you hand it a source — a directory, URL, pasted notes, or the conversation you just had — and it distills the repeatable steps into a new .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, or folds new learnings into an existing skill.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say /learn, "learn this", "turn this into a skill", or ask to update an existing skill.

say_en.text: /learn turn what we just did into a skill

say_en.note: Fetches the page and writes the skill

say_en.text: Update the wow-on-steam-deck skill with these new findings
say_en.note: Edits the existing skill in place
